sources.sections_read: Introduction; Named Arguments; integration with other features
sources.confirmed: Scala 2.8 named arguments can be reordered while expressions retain call-site evaluation order; named arguments interact with overload resolution and by-name parameters. The introduction motivates combining named and default arguments to improve flexible calls.
sources.limits: This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C24.json.

sources.title: Lombok required/all-arguments constructor generation
sources.sections_read: Overview; generated Java example; supported configuration keys
sources.confirmed: Lombok generates field-assigning constructors, selects uninitialized final/non-null fields for required constructors, and supports access levels or private constructors with static factories. Explicit constructors can coexist with generated constructors unless their signatures conflict.
sources.limits: Java-specific compiler integration; signature clashes remain errors, and selecting fields by final/non-null status is less expressive than arbitrary subsets. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C24.json.

sources.title: Lombok builders targeted at a constructor or factory method
sources.sections_read: Version notes; overview; constructor and method builder modes
sources.confirmed: Lombok generates mutable builders whose build method calls a selected method or constructor, allowing control of the target's exposed parameters. The current page identifies separate versions for initial Builder support, Singular, Builder.Default, and access customization.
sources.limits: Builders add mutable staging state and a separate API; class-level generation conflicts with explicit constructors, so constructor/factory targeting matters. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C24.json.

sources.title: attrs 16.1.0 generated initializers with excluded fields and frozen instances
sources.confirmed: attrs 16.1.0 can generate initializers with per-field inclusion, defaults or factories, converters, validators, and frozen instances; fields excluded from constructor arguments can still be initialized from defaults. Frozen support is explicitly new in 16.1.0, with Python runtime immutability limitations.
sources.limits: Later evidence: excluded-field default initialization arrived in May 2016 and frozen support in August 2016; Python freezing is runtime and best-effort. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C24.json.

sources.title: Immutables generated values with default, derived, and lazy attributes
sources.sections_read: Overview; abstract value types; attributes; generated implementation
sources.confirmed: Immutables generates final implementations, supporting fields, constructors, and builders from abstract value types; concrete methods can distinguish computed/defaulted attributes from supplied attributes. The documentation describes values created in a consistent state with mandatory-attribute checks.
sources.limits: Default/derived dependency cycles need detection; lazy attributes have distinct equality semantics, and Java annotation processing needs adaptation. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C24.json.

sources.title: Common Lisp declarative slot initialization and initialization protocol
sources.version_or_date: live HyperSpec; copyright range 1996-2005, not treated as a publication date
sources.confirmed: Common Lisp declaratively maps initialization arguments to selected slots, supplies independent default forms, and invokes author-defined initialization methods around standard slot filling. This separates input selection from custom initialization, but does not itself impose immutable slots.
sources.limits: The protocol does not enforce immutable slots; transferring it requires definite-initialization and immutability rules. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C24.json.

sources.title: Dart initializing-formal parameters and initializer lists
sources.sections_read: In-document find("Using an initializing formal"): Generative Constructors, section 10.6.1; initializing formals and initializer lists
sources.confirmed: Dart initializing formals assign arguments to declared instance fields, can be optional parameters, and coexist with explicit initializer lists; final fields must be initialized and duplicate field initialization is restricted. These rules provide a concise assignment mechanism inside authored constructors.
sources.limits: Applies to fields declared in the same class; each constructor still lists its selected inputs, and duplicate/final initialization rules must transfer carefully.
